description: Lists the webinars of the connected WordPress site: id, title, live or automated, status, the real start with date, time, timezone and length, whether it repeats, and the page address. Take it when a host asks what exists or what runs next, for example "Which webinars do I have right now?" It needs the session id and reads only from the site the host approved. It changes nothing. You can narrow it by id or part of the title, and walk a long list in pages. Without an open connection it says how to connect and returns no data. Then read one of them with wi_get_webinar. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: list webinars, which webinars, what runs next, my webinars

limit.description: How many webinars to return, 1-200. Default 50, newest first.

offset.description: Skip this many of the newest webinars, to walk a long list in pages.

search.description: Narrow the list: an exact campaign id, or part of the title the host sees.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_list_webinars
title: List your webinars
